operations.details_summary: WinHttpFreeProxyResult primary official Microsoft source verified.
Frees allocations contained in an extended WinHTTP proxy result.
Freeing a result is lifecycle hygiene and does not prove the result was valid, applied, or associated with the canonical request.

Evidence is accepted only with exact WinHTTP session/connection/request handle hierarchy, URL and proxy readback, TCP endpoint and owning process, TLS protocol and cipher, remote certificate digest and SSL chain policy, HTTP status/header/body byte count and digest, task, attempt, time window and four receipt correlation.

CertGetCertificateChain primary official Microsoft source verified.
Builds a certificate chain context from an end certificate toward a trusted root under specified usage and time parameters.
A built chain can contain trust errors or use cached stores; chain construction alone is not successful SSL policy verification.

Contains an ordered certificate chain and chain-level trust information.
